snippet.title: PHIBOS - フィボス 彗星を追って
snippet.description:
Phibos: Suisei o Otte by Mizuki, 1995
(Trans: Pursuing the Comet Phibos)
Gameplay video captured using Basilisk II emulator.
Shared with permission from the author.

From the CD-ROM description:

A story of a boy and a star that began with a ray of light. I will deliver to you the enternal dream that I searched for when I was young. Gurioza Forest is full of mysterious things. A young boy, Yoni, travels in search of his missing grandfather. A star that fell from the far reaches of the universe due to the appearance of a supernova. Meet Phibos. With the help of her friends in the forest, Yoni tries to return Phibos to space once again.
